newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai T-bill repo rates end down, spots up.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai T-bill repo rates end down, spots up.

text.p: Contracts on the treasury bill repurchase market in Shanghai closed down across the board on Thursday on institutional selling, traders said.
Tha annual rate for the most active seven-day contract fell to 10.51 percent from 11.30 percent on Wednesday.
Turnover rose to 7.84 million lots from 4.82 million. One lot is 1,000 yuan face value of treasury bills.

"The rates were pulled down by big institutions who sold heavily on the market today," said one trader. "The repo market seemed to have enough money, with a large inflow of liquidity from south China."
